resourceVersion.description: Omit for creation; exact current Kubernetes value for update.

durationMs.description: Only SUCCEEDED, positive replicas, continuous observation of same UID/generation. Includes on-request distribution and rollout. SCALE is not a deployment benchmark.

Offload.description: Only execution=TERMINAL. Presence explicitly allows offloading. DQN requires modelVersion; RULE forbids it. Reuses existing Binding scope.

DqnModel.description: Linear/ReLU/Linear row-major weights. Java validates matching hidden dimensions and finite bounded values. No built-in model.

OffloadingSample.description: One observation per Attempt; not an Execution state mirror. Timings include platform service overhead, not algorithm-only SDK timing.

values.description: SELECT only: ordered nonblank string options. SELECT requires values; defaultValue and supplied non-null values must be members.

port.description: A declared task output; Loop ports contain ordered arrays.

path.description: Starts with value or index; only inside a Loop item.

condition.description: If expression must render true or false; choice persisted

Task.description: Log requires message; Sleep requires duration. Application/Http/Sql require timeout and their matching container/http/sql section, forbidding message/duration. Http supports GET/POST; POST forbids retry. Sql supports one parameterized read-only SELECT. Sequential/Parallel/Dag require tasks; If requires condition and then, optionally else. Control tasks forbid message/duration/retry/timeout. dependsOn is allowed only on direct children of the same Dag; referenced task outputs must be upstream. Task IDs are globally unique; max 100 tasks, nesting max 16. Leaf durations/timeout/retry interval: PT0.001S..PT24H.

Repeat.description: Fixed 1..100 iterations, resolved at start. Matching initial/feedback state keys, excluding iterations/iterationCount. Each round is a barrier; no nested Repeat. External consumers reference Repeat outputs, never its children.

Loop.description: Snapshot an array of 0..1000 items; sequential child tasks per item. Bounded concurrent groups. Declared outputs collected in input order after all items succeed. Repeat may contain Loop; Loop cannot contain Repeat/Loop. See s5-loop.md.

candidateClusters.description: Resolve to a nonempty unique array. Static arrays normalize to LITERAL at parse time.

execution.description: TERMINAL requires authenticated edge ingress provenance and an administrator-configured Docker context. It forbids container.candidateClusters; CLUSTER requires them and forbids offload.

namespaceFiles.description: Local input filename -> same-namespace pinned UTF-8 file revision. /cea-work/in/<name>; at most 256KiB total.

Container.description: Explicit application task. Requires timeout. Inputs staged at /cea-work/in/name; outputs collected from /cea-work/out/name. Dataset parameter P also injects P_PATH. No automatic Flow inputs. See s4-job-execution.md.

webhook.description: Opt-in authenticated POST webhook; JSON body contains Flow inputs

afterExecution.description: Durable same-chain tasks after terminal result; failures never rewrite result; inspect TaskRuns

slaViolatedAt.description: First Executor observation exceeding SLA, durable; null if not observed

Execution.description: QUEUED has not been admitted. CREATED/RUNNING/KILLING occupy a Flow concurrency slot until Finally completes. FAIL admission returns a terminal FAILED execution without attempts or cleanup.

parentTaskRunId.description: Nearest dynamic Repeat/Loop parent TaskRun UUID; null at root scope

iteration.description: Zero at root; one-based local round/item ordinal under its dynamic parent. item.index is zero-based.

TaskRun.description: Control tasks have TaskRuns but no Attempts. If outputs evaluationResult once; unselected descendants are SKIPPED. QUEUED and KILLING apply only to Execution.

ResourceCluster.description: Administrator-declared cluster; enabled is permission to use, not observed health. Contains no endpoint or credentials.

uri.description: s3://bucket/key object locator, without endpoint credentials, query, fragment, port or parent traversal.

DatasetVersion.description: Immutable registration including its location set. Repeating the same registration (location order ignored) returns 200; different content at the same version returns 409. Registration does not upload or verify object existence.

reasons.description: CLUSTER_DISABLED, FORMAT_MISMATCH:dataset/version, DATASET_NOT_LOCAL:dataset/version; all apply cumulatively.

image.description: Explicit repository:tag or repository@sha256:digest. Reference syntax only; not pulled or verified.

resourceVersion.description: Omit for creation; exact current Kubernetes value for update.

when.description: Existing Pebble condition over inputs/vars; must render true to admit execution

maxDuration.description: ISO-8601 PT0.001S..PT24H, elapsed startedAt to main completion including Errors/Finally; violation only, not cancellation
